reserve.description: When true and the path is available, atomically reserve it under the caller and return the resulting DidRecord.

domain.description: Optional explicit hosting domain for the reservation. Honored only when `reserve: true`.

Response.title: DID Management Check Name — response payload

available.description: True iff the path is currently free to register.

reserved.description: True iff a reservation was committed in this call. Implies the request set `reserve: true` AND the path was available.

record.description: Present iff `reserved === true`. Carries the newly-committed DidRecord with `versionCount: 0`.
